run_generate_tapvid: run the tapvid annotation generator script to create pickle shards from raw videos and CSV annotations
build_extract_frames: build a function that extracts JPEG frames from a video file at a specified FPS using ffmpeg
create_csv_to_dataset: create a dataset of Video objects by parsing a CSV file and mapping video paths from a root directory
generate_example_video: generate a dictionary example containing encoded video frames, normalized points, and occlusion flags from a Video object
get_paths_to_videos: get a mapping of video names to file paths by recursively scanning a video root directory for MP4 files
